summary: Added and built the universal macOS app/release packaging path. The local ad-hoc-signed app contains arm64 and x86_64 slices and packages below the GitVerse release asset limit. Developer ID/notarization and app runtime acceptance remain open.

checks.name: macOS release package script tests
checks.observation: The test package is emitted and a mismatched app-version/release-tag pair is rejected.

checks.name: macOS universal Release build
checks.observation: BOOHTACORD.app built at 94.7 MB; the main executable contains x86_64 and arm64 slices. Xcode emitted dependency/compiler warnings but completed successfully.

checks.name: Sandbox entitlements and ad-hoc signature
checks.observation: The signature verifies. The effective release entitlements retain App Sandbox, network client/server and user-selected-file read-write access; there is no broad all-files entitlement.

checks.name: Versioned GitVerse package and SHA-256
checks.observation: ZIP size is 40,061,559 bytes (about 38.2 MiB), below the 95 MB safety ceiling; SHA-256 is cc5a1104a374a8a1277f4599b89b5784ad9f53bae841a4ab8a4d5134bba68bcf and shasum -c passes.

checks.name: Developer ID signing, notarization and macOS runtime acceptance
checks.observation: No valid Developer ID identity is available on this Mac. The app was not launched for login/session persistence, attachment-save UI, voice or screen-share acceptance; an ad-hoc signature does not prove Gatekeeper/notarization behavior.

checks.name: GitVerse macOS CI/release workflow
checks.observation: Workflow source is committed, but its self-hosted macOS runner and tag-triggered GitVerse publication were not invoked during this local validation.

remaining: Configure Developer ID signing/notarization, run the pushed macOS CI workflow, test app launch/session persistence and saving a protected attachment through NSSavePanel, then exercise real voice/screen-sharing peers.
